label: Пойти
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for пойти (to set off, to go).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person perfective future. 'Пойду' is the 1sg future of perfective пойти, formed with prefix по- on the future stem пойд-. Perfective verbs have no present tense, so this form carries future meaning by itself.

missions.phrase: Ты пойдёшь со мной на концерт?
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Second-person future invitation. 'Пойдёшь' is the 2sg future of пойти, end-stressed on the ё. The ё is mandatory and must be typed exactly. Compare the imperfective partner ходить for repeated trips.

missions.phrase: После обеда он пойдёт на работу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person future. 'Пойдёт' is the 3sg future of пойти. 'На работу' uses на + accusative for direction 'to work'. The prefix по- signals the onset of a single completed departure.

missions.phrase: В субботу мы пойдём в музей.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person plural future. 'Пойдём' is the 1pl future of пойти and doubles as the everyday 'let's go'. 'В музей' uses в + accusative 'to the museum'.
Strategic focus: Polite/plural future. 'Пойдёте' is the 2pl future of пойти, contrasted here with 'поедете' for going by vehicle. The ё stays stressed across this future stem.

Strategic focus: Third-person plural future. 'Пойдут' is the 3pl future, completing the future scaffold of пойти. 'В гости' is the fixed phrase 'to visit'. Note the future stem пойд- across all six persons.
Strategic focus: Suppletive masculine past. 'Пошёл' is prefix по- on the suppletive past root ш-, with no и and no д. It is the masculine past of пойти and reports a single completed departure.

Strategic focus: Suppletive feminine past. 'Пошла' uses the irregular ш- past root with the perfective prefix, marking a female subject. Past tense tracks gender, not person, so the form changes with the subject's gender.

missions.phrase: Дети пошли в парк после школы.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Suppletive plural past. 'Пошли' is the plural past of пойти on the suppletive ш- root, sharing nothing with the future stem пойд-. 'В парк' uses в + accusative for direction.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Пойди' is the informal command from пойти, telling someone to go do one thing. The everyday neutral alternative is the simpler imperative иди from идти.
